chunks.title: Leaves of Absence — Overview
chunks.text: Northwind Engineering offers several types of leave of absence, including family and medical leave, parental leave, bereavement leave, and jury duty leave. This section describes who is eligible for each type of leave and how to request it. Some leaves are unpaid and some are paid, as specified in the sections below.

chunks.title: Family and Medical Leave
chunks.text: Eligible employees may take up to 6 weeks of unpaid family and medical leave in a rolling 12-month period for a qualifying reason. [SUPERSEDED by the 2026-01 revision of LV-4.2.]

chunks.title: Family and Medical Leave
chunks.text: Eligible employees may take up to 8 weeks of unpaid family and medical leave in a rolling 12-month period for a qualifying reason, including the employee's own serious health condition or the need to care for a spouse, child, or parent with a serious health condition.

chunks.title: Parental Leave
chunks.text: Northwind provides up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave for the birth of a child or the placement of a child for adoption or foster care. Paid parental leave is provided in addition to any unpaid family and medical leave for which the employee is eligible.

chunks.title: Requesting Leave and Advance Notice
chunks.text: Employees must submit leave requests through the HR portal at least 30 days in advance when the need for leave is foreseeable. When the need for leave is not foreseeable, employees must give notice as soon as practicable, generally within two business days of learning of the need.

chunks.title: Bereavement Leave
chunks.text: Employees may take up to 5 days of paid bereavement leave following the death of an immediate family member. Additional unpaid time may be granted at the manager's discretion.

chunks.title: Jury Duty Leave
chunks.text: Employees called to jury duty are granted paid leave for the duration of their service. Employees must present the jury summons to their manager and the HR portal when requesting the leave.
